overview.description: The Intelligent Alpha Atlas ETF (GPT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation through an actively managed portfolio of 60-90 global large-cap companies. Stock selection relies on AI and human synergy. GPT was launched on Sep 17, 2024 and is issued by Alpha.
